thread:
alice: Heads-up: p95 decode latency on canary up ~22% after merge 6d3f2. Short-seq (<32) tail looks worst. From dashboard: decode_p95 went 12ms -> 15ms on shortseq buckets. :eyes:
ben: Repro'd locally on a single G4. Ran `./perf/run_decode_bench --seq 16 --iters 1000` -> p95 17ms vs baseline 13ms. Putting raw bench output in the trace dir.
carlos: I captured nvprof + CPU flame — kernel switch at step 3 shows an extra fallback to `attention_kernel_generic`. Looks like fused-attn -> fallback path triggered when seq % 16 != 0. nvprof snippet: ```GPU time  ms  name
  12.3    attention_kernel_generic
   2.1    compact_qkv_fast```
diana: Any recent change touching kernel selection heuristics or the padding/align code? I recall PR #4287 tweaked scheduling window for fused ops.
alice: yes that PR changed the batcher decision to favor earlier KV eviction under memory pressure. It shouldn't directly flip kernel selection but it did touch batching heuristics. PR: https://git.internal/pr/4287
ben: I did a quick git bisect: regression lands on commit 6d3f2. The diff touches `kernel_picker.cpp` where we added a heuristic that skips optimized kernels for "small batch shapes".
carlos: that matches my logs. From canary: ```KERNEL_CHOICE: compact_qkv_fast chosen=false reason=shape_skipped
KERNEL_HEUR: batch=3,seqlen=16,heads=12```
diana: OK that explains it. Skipping the optimized kernel for those small batches falls back to generic attn which is slower on CUDA 11.8 for this model. Suggest revert or refine the shape check.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy: 2026-03-17T16:02Z deployed commit 6d3f2 to canary pool (3 hosts) :rocket:
alice: Proposal: hotfix to relax the `shape_skipped` rule to allow sequences <=32 when heads % 8 == 0. I'll open a PR with tests.
ben: Also noticed KV prefetch eviction spikes in perf traces — `kv_cache_evict` correlates with kernel fallback frequency. Not sure which is upstream.
carlos: My theory: small batches -> no fused kernel -> slower per-token -> scheduler backs up -> more concurrent sessions -> memory pressure -> KV eviction spike. It's an amplification loop, not independent.
diana: Plan: 1) revert heuristic on canary (hotfix), 2) add regression test for batch/shape combos, 3) add metric alert for `kernel_choice.fallback_rate`. Who can cut revert now?
ben: I can cut the hotfix. Running: `git revert --no-commit 6d3f2 && make perf-bench` then push. Will follow up with PR.
alice: Please also add unit tests to `kernel_selector_tests` for shapes b=1..4, seqlen in {8,16,32}, heads in {8,12} -> expect `compact_qkv_fast`.
deploy-bot: roll-start: hotfix-revert-6d3f2 -> canary (3 hosts). CI: perf-bench running.
ben: CI perf run finished: seq16 p95 back to 13ms on the bench VM. :thumbsup:
carlos: Saved perf traces and nvprof captures under `/perf/traces/2895002468/` for the postmortem.
diana: If canary stays stable for 30m we'll promote. Good catch everyone, nice bisect. :clap:
